verdict.rationale: Benchmark documents some built-in bulk actions: importing contacts from spreadsheets or other platforms, exporting all contacts and lists at any time, and merging lists via the API. There is no evidence of general bulk or batch operations, such as mass-editing, tagging or deleting many contacts or campaigns in one call, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm batch endpoints. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch API endpoints, bulk edit/delete/tag across many contacts or campaigns, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bring your contacts over from spreadsheets or other platforms with just a few clicks
Export your contacts and lists at any time.
Create, rename, duplicate, merge, and delete lists from another system.
